steps.content:
<color=#b0e7b4>Hopeless Romantic: Well, the hero always shows up at the critical moment.

Hopeless Romantic: ${PlayerName}, I'm Hopeless Romantic. I'm here to take you home.</color>
Hot Toddy_815: ... Hopeless Romantic: Hmm? And who are you? Have you seen ${PlayerName}? Hopeless Romantic: Or perhaps I should call him by his more well-known name, Exterminator.

steps.content:
<color=#b0e7b4>Hot Toddy_815: He just left.

Hopeless Romantic: I see, we missed each other by seconds... This is a test every hero must face until the happy ending. A trial of love, I understand now.</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Hot Toddy_815: She just left.

steps.content:
<color=#b0e7b4>I risked exposing my identity as a Sinner and used my power to trace your steps in the digital world just to meet you.

Sadly but also fortunately, you are not here.

I thought the thrilling experience we shared would change your opinion of me, but now I know there are no shortcuts to winning your heart.</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>I don't know where you are, but I'm sure you're doing your best. I hope what I have done can at least help you a little.

Hopefully, when we meet again, we can call each other by our real names.

Forever waiting for you, Shawn.</color>
<color=#b0e7b4>Hopeless Romantic: There you have the sob story and the confession. I'm just a tiny gesture away from making him swoon.</color>
steps.female_content: <color=#b0e7b4>Hopeless Romantic: There you have the sob story and the confession. I'm just a tiny gesture away from making her swoon.</color>
